subject: Cannot load and run MSstats in R?

messages.author: 8b258e9f101c9d73
messages.subject: Cannot load and run MSstats in R?
parts:
Hello,

Can you please provide clear instructions on which R version I should install and the commands I need to invoke to run MSstats and convert MaxQuant to MSstats formatted data.

I have attempted to invoke the following commands in 3.2.1 with no success:

install.packages(c("gplots","lme4","ggplot2","ggrepel","reshape","reshape2","data.table","Rcpp","survival", "minpack.lm"))
source("https://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite(c("limma","marray","preprocessCore","MSnbase"))
biocLite("MSstats")
library(MSstats)
library(ggplot2)
library(stats)
ppp <-read.table("proteinGroups.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE)
iii <- read.table("evidence.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE)
aaa <- read.csv("annotation.csv", header=TRUE)
raw <- MaxQtoMSstatsFormat(evidence=iii, annotation=aaa, proteinGroups=ppp)
head(raw)

The result for raw returns empty rows.

This had been working just fine on my input objects and now it is not.

Please let me know what R version I should install and the commands I need to run to have work correctly.

Thanks,

Kory Johnson

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Cannot load and run MSstats in R?
parts:
Dear Kory,

Current version of MSstats is v 3.7.3. We updated some for MaxQuant converter function in MSstats for current MaxQuant output. I recommend to use the most current version. If you still have issue with v3.7.3, please let us know.

- Meena
